name: typewriter
title: Typewriter
description: Type a string one character at a time. Static for reduced motion.
a11y: Screen readers get the full text at once from an sr-only copy; the typed characters are aria-hidden.
With prefers-reduced-motion the full text shows immediately and the caret does not blink.

props.name: text
props.description: The string to type. Screen readers get all of it at once.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds to wait before the first character. Default 0.

props.name: cursor
props.description: Show a blinking caret. Default true.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once the last character is shown (also straight away for reduced motion).

usage: import {Typewriter} from '@monoline/react';
